note: Both sets share the same garbled entities ("n-axis telescope", "axis telescope") produced by truncating on-axis/off-axis, and both duplicate many claims. Set A binds values more faithfully overall (21 supported claims vs 19), keeping Lynx's 3 m as the grazing-incidence mirror-assembly diameter and its 10 m as focal length, whereas Set B twice misbinds the 10 m focal length as mirror-assembly "size" and leaves Lynx's 3 m as an unqualified "diameter". Set B's one clear advantage is that it captures LUVOIR-B (8 m aperture, three science instruments), which Set A omits entirely. On balance Set A's fewer misbindings outweigh Set B's better coverage of LUVOIR-B.
